hints: A segment tree can store the minimum for each covered interval.
Build leaves from array values and each parent as the smaller of its children.
A range query combines only tree nodes fully inside the requested interval.
analogy: Store the smallest value in nested intervals so each query can use a few precomputed pieces.
example: For [5,2,7,1], the minimum on positions 2..4 is min(2,7,1)=1.
algorithm: Build a segment tree for range minimum. Query [a,b] recursively: use a node fully covered, skip disjoint nodes, and combine overlapping children.
correctness: The tree partitions the requested interval into disjoint covered nodes; taking their minimum equals the minimum of every array element in the interval.
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n) per query, and O(n) space.
